name: playbook
description: How a project is set up and how work moves through it, for any kind of project: a small standard for laying out and describing projects, tracker docs that tell agents how to read and write tickets in any tracker, and skills to set up or adopt a project, chart open decisions as a map, turn a finished plan into tickets, capture a ticket, tackle one, say where a project stands and what comes next, and think the work through (grill a plan, sharpen terms, research, prototype, untangle).

interface.shortDescription: Set up a project and move its work through a tracker.
interface.longDescription: A standard for a flat projects root, the files every project carries (including a local copy of the conventions and a base block in AGENTS.md), a project.yaml manifest, naming, remotes and visibility, worktrees, and where a project's decisions, research, and plans live. Tracker docs tell an agent how to read and write tickets in any tracker. Skills create or adopt a project, keep adopted projects current, chart and work a map of open decisions, turn a finished plan into tickets, capture one ticket, tackle a ticket through to an honest close, and say where a project stands and which skill comes next; others grill a plan, sharpen a project's terms, research a question from primary sources, prototype a design question, and untangle a pile into plain, small decisions.
interface.defaultPrompt: Start a new project to the standard.
